notes: Counting: claims_audited counts distinct assertions (prose sentences, key-concept sub-claims, table rows, pattern and anti-pattern items, worked-example steps, integration rows, lens-section claims, runtime-trigger rows, integrity-note items). Each finding is one non-faithful line-level claim; a finding covering two sub-claims on one line counts once, so faithful = claims_audited - findings. Recurring claims are listed at each occurrence (procedural justice sustaining commitment: D007, D015, D022; tacit knowledge / Nonaka: D004, D016, D023, D033, D039; three-to-five alternatives: D013, D036; culture-change quote: D018, D030). Quote check: every [V] span was compared with the deep ref and the converted source. SDT (source 10155), expectancy (10897), BATNA (21975), auditors (16862), Larkin (16921), GE forced ranking (25742, omits 'negatively', substring intact), positive reinforcement (5242) and complex change (24530) all match word for word. The complex-change quote is [V] in the distillation but [AP] in deep 725; the words are verbatim in the source, so the distillation's marker fits and the deep ref should be re-marked [V]. Integration rows for jones-evidence-based-sweng (bi-exponential fault pattern, estimation, folklore metrics), letaw-handbook-sweng-methods (RACI, microservices, triple constraint, Tuckman), openstax-business-ethics (normative stakeholder theory, social contract), openstax-business-law, openstax-principles-marketing (service-profit chain, Gap Model, 5A journey), openstax-entrepreneurship (canvas, funding stages), nhs-just-culture-guide (system before individual) and tc-25-20-army-aar checked against those deep refs by targeted grep and hold; only the principles-management row fails (D033). All 17 runtime-trigger labels match tasks/software-business.md verbatim. The derived-from-deep sha256 (a475cbbb...) matches the current deep ref. The Thomas-mode glosses at lines 115 and 218 (compromising under time pressure and equal power; avoiding when symptomatic) go beyond deep 444-448 but match source Exhibit 14.4 (21206, 21232), so they pass as applied guidance.
